decisions.reason: Grounds analysis in console-split-chunks.txt: entry chunk returned 200 while content-hashed siblings (src-BfvxrPJe.js, pie-WAS4IAKB-CQHCQWWM.js) were never shipped; explains the browser must resolve/fetch the chunk's own static imports before instantiating, one 404 rejects the whole import() with fallback to a code block, and prescribes one self-contained chunk with code-splitting off (inlineDynamicImports / splitting:false).

Names the exact mechanism from ci-note.md and chunk-route.ts: LIB_DIR keeps URL drive-letter casing (E:\) while realpathSync returns OS-canonical casing (e:\) on Windows, and the case-sensitive startsWith(LIB_DIR + sep) containment check misjudges the contained path as escaping; explains Linux CI green via no casing drift and explicitly rejects 'Windows paths are unreliable' as folklore.

Anchors the fix to the failing startsWith comparisons and gives the path.relative containment idiom (reject .. / absolute results) with win32 case-insensitive matching explained, keeps realpath under the same rule as defense-in-depth, and covers the JS MIME requirement for dynamic import, noting the route already sends application/javascript.

Reaches a correct dual ownership rule (modal handler consumes the gesture AND pane handler explicitly stands down via a modal-presence/composedPath check), but the core diagnosis contradicts the fixture: it attributes the double-fire to bubbling with the modal firing first and calls listener ordering irrelevant, whereas the pane handler is a document-level capture listener that runs before modal handlers, so modal-side stopPropagation alone cannot disarm it — the report claims it can.

Covers three of four elements: build assertion of one chunk with no hashed siblings, containment serving a case-differing path with 200 while still rejecting ../ and absolute escapes, and modal-open Ctrl+wheel scaling the diagram without pane font change plus modal-closed and lifecycle tests. It never proposes asserting that an unreachable/stubbed chunk URL degrades the fence to the original code block rather than an error or blank (its sibling-200 e2e only checks reachability).
